title: Bloodwood Bow
html:
Crafted (Bowyer Lv 61)

Skill needed

Wielding it takes the Bow weapon skill. Archers start with it. Everyone else can study a Bow tome (1 skill point; vendors no longer sell them, so look on the Exchange).

See Weapon skills & specials for how the skill levels and what it unlocks.

How to get it

Crafted with Bowyer at level 61 (11016 XP) from 4× Bloodwood Wood, 10× Frostwool.
